status: Data drop 5 of the geometric LOD study: drop 4's results on atlas release 2.4.0 inputs (every stage at BEMGen 35e8a132), now timed by R5, the serial timing pass run on an otherwise idle machine (BEMGen stage LOD2-R5, D-265), and without the processor-time ratio of the parallel stage runs (D-266). Schema 1.2.0 as before. The recommendations are drop 4's unchanged (R3: 213 of 264 cells; R4: 18 of 22); the files differ from drop 4's only by the cost and timing members R5 adds and the cpu_time_ratio member D-266 removes. R5 timed 244 sites of 12 test cases (12 references and 232 test sites, 732 runs) on 2026-11-02 from about 04:20 to 05:11 local time without interruption, the machine's total processor load 5.6 % on average and at most 9.5 %. The gate (processor-time CV below 5 % over the three repeats) is not met by 2 of 244 sites, both 0.9 s supermarket 3C runs, so the costs are medians (D-202); the late-repeat slowdown of the earlier timed drop did not recur. No repeat check between sessions was run for this drop. The medium office and the large hotel are not among the timed test cases.

study.name: lod-study-v1
study.title: How Much Thermal Zoning Detail Is Enough?
study.design: Each test case is one DOE/PNNL prototype building generated by BEMGen's DOE generator at the prototype's own dimensions, with the skylights of its programs' atlas family laid out as the source does, the prototype's atlas programs (deterministic ruleset schedules; no daylighting control, no unoccupied lighting cap), the atlas 90.1 unified construction set of its vintage and climate zone, and the pinned TMY3 weather of the zone's representative city. The reference site is the prototype's full zoning (NoSimplification + Stack, IWHT and FHT on); the test sites are the zoning simplifications with geometry, programs, envelope and weather fixed. Ideal-loads sensible heating and cooling are the primary outputs; HVAC and service hot water are excluded.

atlas_inputs.ids: release 2.4.0 IDs, the site release's: no ID translation applies (lod_site.id_translation maps only the releases after the inputs')
notes: The medium office takes the programs of the detailed folder medium-office-detailed, one per room space type, which release 2.4.0 leaves unchanged, so release 2.4.0's PNNL office lighting power (ADR 0060) does not reach this study; taking the whole-building program instead would change the study's design (BEMGen D-262, for the owner).

The 90.1-2007 small hotel takes one building-scope construction set, the residential row of the source's pair; the prototype gives the guest rooms the residential and the other spaces the nonresidential rows (BEMGen D-261, for the owner).
Daylighting control and the unoccupied lighting cap are off in every model, although 13 of the study's 90.1-2019 program keys carry PNNL's cap rule in release 2.4.0 (BEMGen D-261, D-262).

threshold.basis: ASHRAE Guideline 14 hourly limits (CV(RMSE) 30 %, NMBE 10 %), annual error 10 %, conditioned area 1 %; proposed, the owner decides

R3.gate: complete: 5280 of 5280 simulated sites succeeded; 1056 refused by the generator by documented limits (listed with their reason)

R4.gate: complete: 1760 of 1760 simulated sites succeeded; 352 refused by the generator by documented limits (listed with their reason)

R5.gate: CPU-time CV < 5 %: 242 of 244 sites, not met; reported as medians (D-202)
R5.session: 2026-11-02, the timing pass from about 04:20 to 05:11 local time: 732 of 732 runs, no interruption, no resume
R5.load: the machine otherwise idle: total processor load 5.6 % on average and at most 9.5 % in 30-s samples, one sample with a foreign process (a system service, 2.8 %)
R5.drift: each repeat's median over the sites' medians is 1.000, and the third repeat of the 40 sites of at least 4 s a median 0.996 of the mean of the first two (at most 1.024): the late-repeat slowdown of the earlier timed drop did not recur (D-265)
R5.repeat_check: not run for this drop: a check between sessions needs a second session on an otherwise idle machine (D-265)

R6.stage: R6 study report, methodology and consolidated results
R6.gate: written by scripts/lod-study/study_tables.py --write from report.py of D-266 and compared with the archived drop; tables verified by --check (D-264, D-265, D-266)
